entries.wording: 商家已拣货打包，待发往GOOD快递站点【Label created】
entries.note: The sender has packed the parcel for a GOOD station; GOOD does not hold it yet. The row opens with 【美国US】, which becomes the location.

entries.wording: 请【 上传身份证 】【Please uploade identification】
entries.note: GOOD's request, written beside the label, that the recipient upload their identity card for Chinese customs; the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before. The page links the upload form from it.

entries.wording: 包裹已送达美国GOOD快递集散中心，等待发货【Package arrived at GOOD Express dispatch center,awaiting for departure】
entries.note: GOOD's first scan of the parcel, at its US dispatch center.

entries.wording: 包裹已出GOOD快递海外集散中心，送往机场仓库 【Package departure from GOOD Express dispatch center to US airport airline dispatch center】
国际干线揽收【Package has arrived at the airline】
包裹已安排航班，飞往国内口岸【Airline departures from US airport to CHN】

entries.note: Its 【】 names the flight, not a country, so it stays in the wording.

entries.wording: 航班到达国内口岸，等待提货至监管仓【Package arrived at CHN,awaiting for customs clearance】
entries.note: The flight has landed in China and the parcel waits to be taken to the bonded warehouse; clearance has not started.

entries.wording: 包裹信息审核完毕，等待安排通关【Package cleared from customs,awaiting for release】
entries.note: The Chinese says the parcel's data has been checked and it waits for clearance, which the next row ends; the English says cleared.

entries.wording: 包裹通关完毕，等待国内快递揽收派送【Package released,awaiting for CHN local courier service for final delivery】
快递公司Dispatching delivery：顺丰速运,单号： 587056104998
entries.note: The hand-off to the courier that delivers in China, with its name and number; the page links the number to the courier's site. Any courier and number.

entries.wording: 顺丰速运 已收取快件，您的期待，我们定竭诚守护，不负所托。
entries.note: SF Express takes the parcel from GOOD, mid-journey for the parcel. SF's rows follow in Chinese only.

entries.wording: 快件在【咸阳市渭城区咸阳机场店】完成分拣，准备发往 【西安咸阳转运中心】
entries.note: SF's depots fill the 【】, as in the two rows below.

entries.wording: 快件离开 【咸阳市渭城区咸阳机场店】，已在发往 【西安咸阳转运中心】 的路上
快件到达 【西安咸阳转运中心】
